Office of the Executive Engineer · Maharashtra · IN
No. CC/52/2010/103
Dated: March 31, 2026
Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Steel Truss Bridge — Maharashtra Pkg-103” (large bridges),
awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has
been completed in all respects on September 30, 2010 at a gross executed value of INR
58,69,00,000/- (Rupees 58.69 Crore Only).
On joint measurement and final inspection, the executed quantities were found in order and the
workmanship conforming to the technical specifications forming part of the contract.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Imran Joshi. This certificate is issued for record
and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
performance.
Executive Engineer
Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra
